propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist -n 3 --dist worksteal when a test that calls reconciler main() runs first in the same worker
the reconciler entrypoint install_stderr_handler sets the rebar_reconciler root logger to WARNING level globally and never restores it, poisoning later tests

caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger argument only raises the ROOT logger level, so INFO records from rebar_reconciler are dropped at the originating logger's isEnabledFor check before handlers are consulted
the existing _rebar_log_propagation_guard in tests/conftest.py only covers the rebar root logger, not the sibling rebar_reconciler root, leaving reconciler-side INFO assertions unprotected
the per-item WARNING line was captured but the pass-summary INFO line was not, proving both paths fired and only the INFO line was dropped by level filtering

generalizing the caplog integrity guard from a scalar REBAR_LOGGER_NAME to a tuple SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES containing both rebar and rebar_reconciler closes the flake class by ensuring every test starts from a baseline level state
